one: Neural representations for 3D geometry: point clouds, meshes, implicit fields, and 3D generation.
pos: CS 348N studies how to generate and manipulate high-quality 3D models and scenes with machine learning. It covers geometry representations, 3D datasets, point-cloud/mesh networks, neural implicits, 3D generative models, conditional generation, and evaluation — a core course for 3D generation/graphics.
topics: **Geometry representations**: point clouds, meshes, voxels, SDFs, NeRF
prereq: CS 148; deep learning basics; CS 229 recommended.
assess: Assignments plus a project. Check the current syllabus for details.
who: 3D generation, graphics, AR/VR, and robot simulation.
tips: Learn NeRF and diffusion first, then revisit 3D versions of GAN/VAE. Pair with CS 468.
note: Not offered in the 2026–27 ExploreCourses listing; no stable course-site link found.
